config_excluded.mini: 160 rows, a subset drawn from the five capability configs; excluded to avoid double-counting

A_multiturn_census.turn_definition: Scenario.build_event_id_to_turn_idx: the turn of an event is the number of AgentUserInterface.send_message_to_user events among its ancestors. A turn boundary IS a send_message_to_user event. ReAct/reasoning steps are NOT turns and are not scored decisions.
A_multiturn_census.scored_decision_definition: one OracleEvent of event_type=AGENT, matched by the judge to an agent event

B_verifier_census.mechanism: validation/tool_judge.MildToolJudge: hard checks first; if they pass AND the tool has at least one arg registered as CheckerType.llm_checker, the SoftToolJudge (LLM) also runs. SoftToolJudge.no_arg_to_check is True iff no arg uses llm_checker.
B_verifier_census.structural_reason: send_message_to_user is BOTH the turn delimiter and an LLM-judged tool, so every multi-turn scenario necessarily contains at least one LLM-judged scored event.

C_independence.mechanism: Scenario.soft_reset(): per-app app.reset() then app.load_state(json.loads(_initial_apps[name]['serialized_state'])), then apply_augmentation_configs(), then per-app set_seed(self.seed)
C_independence.kind: in-process state reload (scenario reconstruction from released JSON is also available)
C_independence.note: Each benchmark scenario is rebuilt from its own released JSON row; no mutable state is shared between scenarios.

D_restore.cheapest_mechanism: per-app get_state()/load_state() snapshot + Environment.get_state() (apps + event_log + event_queue + current_time)
alternatives: are/simulation/replay.py replay_logs(world_logs, env) — deterministic replay from the world log
App._skip_deepcopy_fields indicates apps are deepcopy-safe for in-process snapshots
caveats: Environment runs a time-based event loop with a background thread; a checkpoint must pause() the environment first
app.reset() reseeds from app.seed, so RNG-dependent apps are restorable only if the seed is restored with the state
determinism of a replay-based restore was NOT empirically verified in Phase 0

evidence: are/simulation/environment.py:646 — `if type(event) is OracleEvent: if self.oracle_mode: ... else: 'Oracle event ignored as oracle_mode = False'`; in agent mode oracle events are neither executed nor logged
EnvironmentConfig.oracle_mode defaults False and dump_dir/queue_based_loop are rejected unless oracle_mode is on
the judge consumes oracle events and gold graphs through validation/*, a separate object graph from the agent's world logs
E_observable_boundary.note: H_t for ReCoverMem would be Environment.get_world_logs() plus AUI messages and tool observations; oracle events, the oracle graph and judge state are structurally separate and never reach the agent.

F_cross_turn.method: structural only: (a) token overlap between argument/message strings introduced in earlier turns and those required in a later turn; (b) DAG ancestry of a later-turn oracle event on a non-boundary earlier-turn event. No model outcome used.

failing_conditions: a mandatory LLM judge is required for every multi-turn scenario
passing_conditions: no mandatory external API for the environment itself
